items.claim: far-off rect clip stenciled at the wrong place
far-off rect's stencilled aligned stroke marks its fill at the wrong place
typed-array value for a non-array uniform silently dropped
items.note: An `Int32Array`/`Uint32Array` now writes `int`/`ivecN` or `uint`/`uvecN` by its length, and any other length throws in dev.

items.claim: text layer that falls back keeps its uploaded span's GPU buffers
vertex colors with a non-solid paint: fill drops the colors, stroke drops the paint
items.note: This needed a behavior call nobody had made. I chose the stroke's existing rule for both: the vertex colors draw at the paint's opacity. It is recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under "Audit round sixty-three (2026-11-21): renderer.draw".

items.claim: Emoji in gradient- or pattern-filled text ignore the fill's opacity
A batch run without `batchVariants` takes several color matrices but draws them with the single-matrix program
Text decorations and outline-tier glyphs lose float32 precision far from the origin because their meshes carry no origin
A group's color matrix never reaches a registered paint kind, on paths or on glyphs
items.note: This was a behavior call nobody had made, so I made the strict one and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`. A kind's program that declares `u_colorMatrix` and `u_colorBias` is handed them. One that declares neither draws unmapped, and development warns once per program. Text through the scratch pass is covered because that pass binds through `bindPaintKind`. The changeset is `minor` because it adds a uniform convention for kinds.

items.claim: A `Float64Array` given to an array uniform is rejected
A group with effects whose color matrix lowers alpha still claims picking ids at its unmapped alpha
items.note: The id composite now applies the same matrix as the color composite, in both GLSL and WGSL.
